Ada fotografer yang sekadar mengambil gambar. Ada juga yang membuat dunia berhenti sejenak untuk melihat, memahami, dan merasakan. Raghu Rai adalah salah satunya. Karyanya bukan cuma dokumentasi, tapi pengingat bahwa fotografi punya kekuatan besar: menyimpan sejarah, rasa, luka, kehidupan, dan kemanusiaan dalam satu frame. Dari Raghu Rai, kita belajar: kamera bukan cuma alat untuk menangkap momen, tapi cara untuk menghormati cerita yang ada di depan kita. Selamat jalan, legenda. Karyamu akan tetap hidup dalam setiap frame yang mengajarkan dunia untuk lebih peka. Menurut kamu, pelajaran terbesar dari seorang fotografer legendaris seperti Raghu Rai itu apa? Shutter count tinggi bukan berarti kameranya auto jelek. Memang shutter count itu penting buat jadi bahan pertimbangan. Tapi itu bukan satu-satunya penentu kondisi kamera. Karena kamera second yang worth it juga harus dilihat dari: * kondisi fisik body * performa sensor * tombol & dial * mount & layar * riwayat pemakaian * dan tentu aja hasil tes overall-nya Jadi jangan panik dulu kalau lihat angka shutter count tinggi. Yang lebih penting: kameranya masih sehat dipakai atau enggak? Kalau mau cari kamera second yang sudah dicek, dites, dan siap pakai, langsung aja ke Elora Camera!

Banyak orang nunggu momen besar buat bikin foto menarik. Tapi lewat skena “Art of Noticing”, kita diingetin kalau justru hal-hal biasa bisa jadi luar biasa kalau mata kita cukup peka buat melihatnya. Expedición cientifica y Fotografia Macro de aves en Chiapas, Mexico. (Video completo en YouTube @miguelsanmartinwph) En este video te comparto mis experiencias de una expedición científica que se realizó entre finales de febrero y principios de marzo, en una montaña remota de Chiapas, México. En esta salida fui invitado por mi asesora, la Dra. Paula Enríquez de Ecosur, para acompañar a su estudiante de doctorado Sabdiel Roque en su investigación. Durante un par de días, ascendimos más de 1000 metros a través del bosque mesófilo de montaña para llegar a su sitio de estudio, donde se utilizan redes de niebla para evaluar la diversidad de aves y tomar pequeñas muestras de sangre en aves del género Turdus, que permiten analizar la presencia de contaminantes organoclorados. Estos compuestos, derivados de actividades humanas, pueden viajar grandes distancias, y su detección en ecosistemas aparentemente intactos nos ayuda a entender el verdadero alcance del impacto humano sobre la vida silvestre. Además, esta experiencia me permitió explorar una forma distinta de observar a las aves: la fotografía macro. Al acercarnos a un nivel de detalle poco común, es posible revelar estructuras, texturas y patrones que normalmente pasan desapercibidos. Este video es un vistazo al trabajo de campo, a los procesos detrás de la investigación científica y a la importancia de documentar y comunicar lo que ocurre en estos ecosistemas. Agradecimientos Investigación: Sabdiel Roque y su asesora, la Dra. Paula Enríquez Institución: El Colegio de la Frontera Sur (ECOSUR) Acompañamiento y documentación: Miguel Ángel San Martín Cruz Fotografias realizadas con el lente @tamronmexico 90 Macro.  #tamronmexico #tamroncreators #conservationphotography #aves #birdphotography  Notas éticas Ningún ave fue lastimada durante este proceso. El manejo se realizó por personal capacitado, bajo protocolos éticos y con los permisos correspondientes de la SEMARNAT. El uso del flash fue mínimo y controlado.
It's all in the eyes.  #Hummingbirds #wildlifephotography #birdphotography #aves #Colibríes

Espero que estén teniendo un hermoso dia e inicio de semana. Les dejo una colección de fotografías que muestran un poco del amor de una madre en el mundo de las aves.  1. Chara verde (Cyanocorax yncas) alimentando a su cria Durante la hora dorada del amanecer 2. Cuclillo canelo (Piaya cayana) en el nido 3 y 4. Papamoscas copeton (Mitrephanes phaeocercus) alimentando y cuidando de su cria 5. Luis pico grueso (Megarynvhus pitangua) en el nido 6. Pareja de cabezón degollado (Pachyramphus aglaiae) trabajando duro en el nido para sus futuros bebés 7. Hola a todos, intentaré poco a poco ir publicando muchas de las fotografías que tengo pendientes desde gran parte de 2025, pues entre el trabajo y cosas personales lo fui dejando. Me gustaría comenzar con esta serie de fotografías que realicé en la víspera del estreno de nuestro documental Alas de Esperanza, justo el fin de semana después de estrenar el documental en el INECOL por allá de abril de 2025.  Esta pajareada fue organizada por el equipo de Aveoptica. Alexis Jarvio fue nuestro guía, y también nos acompañó Ale Madera, parte de los protagonistas del documental. Entre los asistentes tuvimos la compañía del pequeño Aldair,  Ismael, el Dr. Sergio Cabrera del INECOL, @Sandy Li Enlo  y un servidor.  En esta salida registramos 59 especies y vimos una gran migración de rapaces justo mientras ibamos terminando el recorrido.  Especies de las fotografías: 1.Papamoscas cardenalito (Pyrocephalus rubinus) 2.Colorin sietecolores (Passerina ciris) 3.Aguililla alas anchas (Buteo platypterus) 4.Gavilan pico de gancho (Chondrohierax uncinatus) 5.Gavilán zancón (Geranospiza caerulescens) 6.Aguililla cola roja (Buteo jamaicensis)  aguililla de alas anchas y zopilote negro (Coragyps atratus) 7 en adelante, una pequeña sesión que le hice a una Matraca Veracruzana (Campylorhynchus rufinucha), especie endémica de nuestro estado. ¿Cuál fue tu foto favorita? A finales de febrero/principios de marzo de 2026 acompañé a Sabdiel Roque, estudiante de doctorado en El Colegio de la Frontera Sur (ECOSUR), durante un muestreo de campo en las altas montañas de Cintalapa, Chiapas. Su trabajo se centra en evaluar la presencia de compuestos organoclorados en aves del género Turdus, así como en documentar la diversidad de especies que habitan las altas montañas de Chiapas. Entre redes de niebla, recorridos en silencio y horas de observación, el bosque comienza a revelarse en fragmentos: colores, texturas y miradas que muchas veces pasan desapercibidas. Rostros del bosque busca ser un acercamiento visual a este entorno, desde una mirada al mundo macro en aves y a los detalles que emergen entre la luz, la sombra y la vida silvestre. Durante esta salida se registraron las siguientes especies:  (Comienzan a partir de la 5a foto) 5. Turdus infuscatus (En peligro de extinción en México). 6. Catharus dryas (Amenazado en México). 7-8. Sclerurus mexicanus (Amenazado en México). 9. Lampornis viridipallens (macho) (Sujeta a protección especial en México). 10. Pampa rufa (Sujeta a protección especial en México). 11-12. Setophaga townsendi. 13. Setophaga virens. 14. Cardellina pusilla. 15-16. Myioborus miniatus (macho). 17. Empidonax sp. 18. Lepidocolaptes affinis. 19. Passerina caerulea (hembra). 20. Campylopterus hemileucurus (hembra). Más allá de los registros, estas fotografías son una invitación a conservar y cuidar de nuestros bosques, pues todas las especies dependen de la continuidad de los ecosistemas.  Sin vegetación, no hay vida que documentar. Fotos tomadas con el Tamron 90 mm macro y Sony A7IV Nota: Ninguna de las aves fue lastimada durante el proceso. Las fotografías se realizaron bajo protocolos de manejo ético por personal capacitado, con un uso mínimo de flash (una toma por individuo), y como parte de un proyecto que cuenta con los permisos de colecta científica correspondientes de la SEMARNAT. Tras el registro fotográfico y la toma de datos, las aves fueron liberadas en el sitio. #aves #macro #conservationphotography #mexico #chiapas

Throughout the years I’ve learned that biggest stressor with my couples has been anxiety around the timeline & worrying there won’t be enough time for X, Y, and Z. That’s why I haven’t switched my package structure over to be timing based on what my clients need. That way if they  end up needing more time - no problem. Part one to my 35mm series : 5 tips for 35mm photography beginners. Part two will be a video actually showing you how to load film into the camera!  1. Be very careful & slow loading your film.  2. Film loves light! The more light you have, the better. Film flashes also really fun!!! especially for wedding receptions / engagement sessions, etc 3. Overexpose slightly. (Digital = protect highlights Film = protect shadows) 4. Be slow & intentional. This is the best part of 35mm film is that you get to be creative & artistic. And each shot really matters in a way that’s sort of been lost on us in the digital world, a bit.  5. Go through  reputable lab! Best Canon G7X Settings for Vacation Content 📸✨ Let’s talk about it… First things first — ALWAYS shoot in P mode. It gives you that perfect mix of control + ease without missing the moment. ISO: Think of this as your brightness setting. The higher the ISO, the brighter the photo/video… but too high = grainy footage. I always try to keep mine low and use natural lighting whenever possible. Continuous Shooting: This is the secret for candid content. Hold the shutter down and your camera snaps multiple shots back-to-back so you can catch the actual moment instead of one stiff photo. Flash: I’m telling you right now… keep the flash ON. The Canon G7X flash gives that clean, iconic digital camera look everyone loves rn — especially for dinners, night walks, vacations, and low-light moments. The G7X is literally the perfect “take everywhere” camera for travel days, cute dinners, beach walks, getting ready content, and everyday memories ✨

Social media constantly pushes us to upgrade to the newest and “best” photography equipment, and we all feel that pressure, I do too. I’ve been tempted to upgrade more times than I can count when I see new releases. This is a reminder for all of you that feel the pressure - often what you have is already good enough!  My equipment still works amazing and ranges between 3-8 years old for various bodies and lenses (perhaps I’ll now jinx it by posting this reel 😂). Here are three things I remind myself of when the upgrade bug hits: 1. You don’t need the newest gear — my 8-year-old DSLR camera still performs perfectly. 2. Don’t shop by brand/releases — shop based on your needs and budget. 3. Second-hand gear is gold — some of my best lenses were bought used.  You don’t need the latest release or a specific brand to take great photos. You need something that feels right, fits your style and budget, and helps you do what you love.   Choose what works for you. That’s what makes it the “best”. #deinfluencing #wildlife #wildlifephotography

Proses ini menggunakan sensor digital atau film untuk menciptakan gambar, baik untuk seni, dokumentasi, maupun komunikasi visual.  Wikipedia Wikipedia  +2 Unsur Dasar & Teknik Segitiga Eksposur: Mengatur aperture (bukaan), shutter speed (kecepatan rana), dan ISO untuk mendapatkan pencahayaan yang tepat. #fotografi🕋 Fotografi ditemukan secara bertahap pada awal abad ke-19, dimulai dengan foto permanen pertama oleh Nicéphore Niépce (1826) menggunakan teknik heliografi. Louis Daguerre menyempurnakannya menjadi Daguerreotype pada 1839, menandai kelahiran fotografi praktis, yang kemudian berevolusi dari kamera film kodak (1888) hingga teknologi digital.  Wikipedia Wikipedia  +3 Berikut adalah poin-poin penting dalam sejarah penemuan fotografi: Prinsip Dasar (Camera Obscura): Konsep kamera sudah ada sejak zaman kuno, namun difungsikan secara ilmiah oleh Ibn al-Haytham (1039) sebagai "kamar gelap" (camera obscura). Foto Permanen Pertama (1826/1827): Nicéphore Niépce, ilmuwan Prancis, berhasil merekam gambar pertama secara permanen menggunakan pelat timah yang dilapisi bitumen of Judea. Kelahiran Fotografi - Daguerreotype (1839): Louis Daguerre, mitra Niépce, mengembangkan daguerreotype yang menghasilkan gambar lebih tajam pada pelat tembaga berlapis perak. Perkembangan Negatif-Positif (1840-an): William Henry Fox Talbot mengembangkan proses calotype (negatif-positif), memungkinkan penggandaan foto. Kamera Kodak (1888): George Eastman memperkenalkan kamera Kodak yang membuat fotografi dapat diakses oleh masyarakat umum.  Gramedia Gramedia  +6 Proses awal membutuhkan waktu paparan (eksposur) yang sangat lama, terkadang berjam-jam, sebelum disempurnakan menjadi metode yang lebih cepat.  Sinoseen Sinoseen #fyp #koko

Wikipedia Wikipedia  +2 Unsur Dasar & Teknik Segitiga Eksposur: Mengatur aperture (bukaan), shutter speed (kecepatan rana), dan ISO untuk mendapatkan pencahayaan yang tepat. Komposisi: Pengaturan elemen foto menggunakan aturan seperti rule of thirds, garis terdepan (leading lines), dan framing. Cahaya: Elemen terpenting dalam fotografi; memahami arah dan kualitas cahaya (natural atau buatan).  DJKN DJKN  +1 Jenis-Jenis Fotografi Potret (Portrait): Fokus pada manusia, wajah, dan ekspresi. Lanskap (Landscape): Mengabadikan pemandangan alam. Jalanan (Street): Mengambil momen spontan di ruang publik. Makro: Memotret objek kecil dari jarak sangat dekat. Arsitektur: Fokus pada desain dan keindahan bangunan. Still Life: Objek mati yang diatur estetis.  YouTube YouTube  +3 Alat & Perlengkapan Kamera: DSLR, mirrorless, atau kamera ponsel. #engineering #optics #y2k #photography #retro  For anyone interested in specifics, the parts are: a dslr (I used a canon eos 80d) a wide angle lens (I used an ef-s 24mm f/2.8 STM) a sacrificial Helios 44-m - more specifically the rear middle element - distinguished by having one large convex side and one small raised concave. a 52mm UV filter with the glass removed to serve as a rear mount a 49-52mm step up ring to provide a metal front thread  the specific STL file I have designed (reach out if interested) and of course a 3d printer or printing service. The lens actually allows you to flip the element backwards which makes the effect MUCH more gentle, instead zooming in slightly and giving a retro film effect.

Chiếc máy ảnh đầu tiên của tớ là một khởi đầu rất “bản năng”. Không kiến thức nền, không kỹ thuật, tớ chỉ đơn giản bắt đầu với những gì mình có: một thân máy nhỏ gọn, kết hợp cùng Sigma 18-50mm f/2.8 cho sự linh hoạt và Viltrox AF 56mm f/1.7 để thử nghiệm chiều sâu hình ảnh. Những ngày đầu, tớ tự mày mò mọi thứ, thậm chí còn hướng dẫn bạn bè cách bấm máy giúp mình. Không hoàn hảo, nhưng đủ để ghi lại những khoảnh khắc rất thật. Chính sự “thiếu chuẩn” đó lại trở thành nền tảng để tớ dần hiểu về ánh sáng, bố cục và cảm xúc trong ảnh. Điều tớ thích nhất là sự gọn nhẹ - một chiếc máy có thể đồng hành trong mọi chuyến đi mà không tạo áp lực. Nhờ vậy, việc chụp ảnh trở nên tự nhiên hơn, không bị giới hạn bởi thiết bị. Photography is a way to capture a moment and tell a story without words. A good photo can show emotions, atmosphere, and details that people might miss in real life. That's why photographs are important: they help us remember events, share experiences, and see the world from different perspectives. There are many types of photos. Portraits focus on a person's face and character. Landscape photos show nature, mountains, the sea, or city views. Street photography captures real life in everyday places. Some photos are taken for art, while others are taken for news, memories, or social media. Light is one of the most important parts of photography. Natural light can make a picture look soft and warm, especially during the "golden hour" (early morning or late evening). Composition also matters: the way objects are placed in the frame can make a photo look balanced and interesting. #hhkb #vibes #setup #photo

If there's one thing I ask for, it's to go follow my other account @Tom 🥹 #HappyNewYear everyone!! #Photography #Videography #Canon #fyp  Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating images by recording light, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film. It is employed in many fields of science, manufacturing (e.g., photolithography), and business, as well as its more direct uses for art, film and video production, recreational purposes, hobby, and mass communication. A person who operates a camera to capture or take photographs is called a photographer, while the captured image, also known as a photograph, is the result produced by the camera. Typically, a lens is used to focus the light reflected or emitted from objects into a real image on the light-sensitive surface inside a camera during a timed exposure. With an electronic image sensor, this produces an electrical charge at each pixel, which is electronically processed and stored in a digital image file for subsequent display or processing. The result with photographic emulsion is an invisible latent image, which is later chemically "developed" into a visible image, either negative or positive, depending on the purpose of the photographic material and the method of processing. A negative image on film is traditionally used to photographically create a positive image on a paper base, known as a print, either by using an enlarger or by contact printing. Before the emergence of digital photography, photographs that utilized film had to be developed to produce negatives or projectable slides, and negatives had to be printed as positive images, usually in enlarged form. This was typically done by photographic laboratories, but many amateur photographers, students, and photographic artists did their own processing.

How to make this stop motion effect with your photos (or more properly known as cinemagraphs) in just 4 steps! A lot of people wanted a tutorial so here it is!  Step 1 - take a lot of similar photos. It helps if you have a tripod and know what you want to move and what you want to stay still at this stage. These are hard to make as an afterthought but not impossible  Step 2 - if you didn’t already, pick what you want to have move. Look at the other photos and see if there’s enough movement and if it makes sense with the scene Step 3 - cut this section out of the similar photos. I use photoshop to do this but I imagine there’s other ways to do it. If your scene wasn’t moving other than the part you want you get to skip this step! Step 4 - put it together! I used the timeline in photoshop for this but just as easily could have used a free app like CapCut. Hope to see people make some! #photography #creative #photographyideas #artist

Looking back there’s a lot of shoots I wish I brought my film camera with me to so don’t be like me and just start bringing that film camera everywhere  #photography #filmphotography #filmisnotdead #photographylife

Tiene la potencia suficiente para compensar la luz dura del sol en sesiones más complejas, pero sigue siendo práctico y relativamente portátil para lo que ofrece. The Sony A7V paired with the Sony FE 35mm f/1.4 GM is one of those combinations that just works. The 35mm focal length feels natural and versatile, while the f/1.4 aperture delivers beautiful subject separation and creamy bokeh without sacrificing sharpness. On the A7V, the lens truly shines... fast, accurate autofocus locks onto eyes effortlessly, and the compact balance makes it ideal for street, portraits, and everyday storytelling. Together, they offer a perfect blend of performance, character, and reliability... a setup that’s hard to put down once you start shooting. I’ve always been a really visual person when it comes to travel. Before I go somewhere, I build out moodboards so I can understand how a place feels before I ever arrive there. For my recent trip to the Faroe Islands, I used @adobefirefly Boards to plan out the entire creative direction of the trip and bring all of those ideas into one place. The AI-powered workflow made it way easier to organize references, creative ideas, and the overall feeling I wanted the trip to have before I even landed there. I think visualizing a trip before you experience it changes the way you shoot when you finally get there. Marre de ne pas comprendre pourquoi tes photos sont floues, sombres ou trop lumineuses ? 😩 Dans cette série, je t’explique simplement les 3 bases de la photo : 📷 ISO, VITESSE, et OUVERTURE. C’est le fameux triangle d’exposition 🔺 💡 OUVERTURE (f/…) → Gère la profondeur de champ (le flou d’arrière-plan). 💡 VITESSE (1/s) → Contrôle le mouvement (figé ou filé). 💡 ISO → Ajuste la sensibilité de ton appareil à la lumière. Comprendre ces trois réglages, c’est reprendre le contrôle de ta créativité ✨ Sauvegarde ce post pour l’avoir toujours sous la main et dis-moi en commentaire 👇 👉 Lequel de ces réglages te pose encore le plus de problème ? #conseilphoto #triangleexposition #photographie #apprendrephoto #iso

1. The Best All-Rounder: Canon EOS R10 Key Strengths: Features world-class AI subject tracking inherited from pro models, including 15fps mechanical burst shooting. Its dual-dial control and guided interface make it incredibly beginner-friendly without sacrificing power. Best For: Sports and wildlife beginners who need high speed and reliable autofocus. Drawbacks: No In-Body Image Stabilization (IBIS); smaller battery compared to full-frame rivals. Price & Kit: $999 kit price; includes the RF-S 18-45mm f/4.5-6.3 IS STM lens. Second Market: Look for "Like New" on MPB or KEH. Aim for a shutter count under 20,000 (rated for 200,000). 2. The Video & Vlog Specialist: Sony ZV-E10 II Key Strengths: A 25.6MP APS-C sensor powerhouse optimized for video with 4K/60p recording and a specialized "Product Showcase" mode. It features a high-quality 3-capsule internal mic and a tally light for recording. Best For: Aspiring content creators, YouTubers, and vloggers. Drawbacks: Lacks a built-in viewfinder (LCD screen only); rolling shutter can be visible in fast action. Price & Kit: $1,099 kit price; includes the 16-50mm f/3.5-5.6 OSS II power zoom lens. Second Market: Available on Gear Focus or Adorama Used. Electronic shutter use is common; check for sensor dust. 3. The Travel & Style Icon: Fujifilm X-E5 Key Strengths: Famed for its tactile film-style dials and "Film Simulations" that produce stunning JPEGs straight from the camera. It uses a high-resolution 40MP sensor in a pocketable, vintage-inspired body. Best For: Travel and street photographers who want high-quality results without computer editing. Drawbacks: Higher price point; small body can feel "cramped" with larger professional lenses. Price & Kit: $1,599 kit price; typically paired with the XF 23mm f/2.8 R WR pancake lens. Second Market: Check eBay (highly rated sellers) or Fujifilm’s refurbished store. Fujifilm gear holds value well. 4. The Action & Hybrid Choice: Nikon Z50 II Key Strengths: Offers the best ergonomics in its class with a deep, comfortable grip and a bright, high-resolution electronic viewfinder. It handles low light exceptionally well for a crop-sensor camera. Best For: Traditionalists who want a rugged camera that feels balanced and "pro" in the hand. Drawbacks: Limited selection of Nikon-brand "DX" lenses compared to Sony’s ecosystem. Price & Kit: $1,049 kit price; includes the Z DX 16-50mm f/3.5-6.3 VR lens. Second Market: Look on Used Photo Pro or B&H Used. Search for units with under 15,000 shutter actuations. ​5. The Best Value/Compact: Olympus (OM System) E-M10 Mark IV Key Strengths: Equipped with a 20.3MP Micro Four Thirds sensor and 5-axis In-Body Image Stabilization (IBIS) that allows for sharp handheld shots even in low light. It is the most compact and portable system on this list. Best For: Hikers and travelers who want a lightweight camera that fits in a jacket pocket. Drawbacks: Smaller sensor means slightly more "noise" in extremely dark settings compared to APS-C. Price & Kit: $799 kit price; includes the 14-42mm f/3.5-5.6 EZ electronic lens. Second Market: Check MPB; Olympus cameras have a hidden menu to check exact shutter counts. #cameratips  #beginnerphotographers  #learnphotography  #techreview  #cameratechnology

生成AIという存在が毎秒毎秒と進化していき、誰にでも「画像」を生み出すことが容易な今、写真家に必要なのは何かと毎日考えます。 前談がなんだろうがその答えを自分が見つけられる気は全くしないけど、AIに対抗するのであればその場にしかないストーリーとか、空気とか、リアリズムが凝縮された写真かもしれない、と最近考えるようになりました。 一方で、「生成AIと写真家が共存」していくのであれば、どんな写真であるべきなのか。 レタッチを楽にしよう、とか ラフ作成を楽にしよう、とか そういう業務改善ではなく、本当の意味での共存とはなにか というのを探してみようと思う日々です。 As generative AI continues to evolve by the second, and as it becomes easier than ever for anyone to create “images,” I find myself thinking every day about what photographers truly need now. No matter what kind of preface I give, I honestly don’t feel like I can arrive at a definitive answer. But if we are to stand against AI, perhaps what matters is photography that condenses the stories, the atmosphere, and the realism that could only exist in that specific moment and place. On the other hand, if photographers and generative AI are to coexist, what kind of photography should we be creating? Not simply using AI to make retouching easier. Not simply using AI to make rough drafts easier. I’ve been spending my days trying to explore what true coexistence might mean in a deeper sense. 2026/05/23 #Leica #leicastreetphotography  #photo  #photography
